06   /   THE PRACTICAL THINGS

Glad
you asked.

Because the beautiful part should begin
long before your wedding day.

Ask us something else ↗
How many guests can the estate accommodate?+

In this concept, The Courtyard hosts 50–150 guests, The Grand Pavilion 200–400, and The Garden Lawn 150–500. The best fit depends on your seating plan and the kind of celebration you have in mind.

Can we host more than one wedding function?+

Yes, the concept brings together three different spaces so you can imagine a courtyard mehendi, a garden ceremony, and an indoor reception. Use the enquiry form to tell us about each function.

What happens if it rains?+

The Grand Pavilion provides an indoor option. At a real venue, an indoor backup, its capacity, and any additional charges should be agreed in writing before you book.

Can we bring our own decorators and caterers?+

This demo is designed around flexible celebrations. Actual vendor policies, kitchen access, setup timings, and any outside-vendor charges would be confirmed with the venue team.

How do we arrange a venue visit?+

Choose “Book a venue visit” and share your preferred wedding date, approximate guest count, and contact details. This demo creates a downloadable enquiry for you to review; it does not send it to a venue.
